scenes.title: First look

scenes.narration: The big question isn't which one looks more impressive. It's how you normally cook dinner.

scenes.title: AF141 daily use
scenes.asset_requirement: Genuine properly authorised AF141ANZ product image and separate real-life small-meal scene; no AI imitation labeled as AF141
scenes.narration: The Ninja AF141 has a single four point seven litre basket. It's a straightforward option for smaller everyday meals.

scenes.title: AF400 dual drawers
scenes.asset_requirement: Genuine properly authorised AF400ANZ product image showing both separate drawers, uncropped; source attribution
scenes.narration: The AF400 has two separate four point seven five litre drawers, nine point five litres combined.

scenes.title: Critical capacity caveat
scenes.asset_requirement: Original high-resolution kitchen illustration clearly showing two SEPARATE drawers and a larger whole chicken on counter; no fake product markings
scenes.narration: But nine point five litres does not mean one enormous basket. Think about the shape of the food, not just the combined volume.

scenes.title: Two dishes
scenes.asset_requirement: Original single-scene editorial cooking shot: roast chicken and vegetables in two distinct dishes; no collage
scenes.narration: Want chicken and vegetables ready together? Two independently controlled drawers make the AF400 genuinely useful.

scenes.title: One simple meal
scenes.asset_requirement: Original full-frame lifestyle scene: two plates of chips and nuggets in small apartment kitchen, photographed as ONE shot
scenes.narration: If you usually reheat leftovers or make one food at a time, the simpler AF141 may be enough.

scenes.title: Family dinner
scenes.asset_requirement: Original full-frame editorial dinner scene with several people and varied dishes, complete faces and hands
scenes.narration: A larger household cooking a main and side regularly may appreciate two cooking zones. But only if those zones get used.

scenes.title: Countertop and price
scenes.asset_requirement: Original premium Australian countertop scene with tape measure and shopping list; do not invent real price tags
scenes.narration: Check the bench space, actual local stock and final delivered price before buying. Deals change.

scenes.title: Five-dinner decision test
scenes.asset_requirement: Native vector five-meal decision illustration and informative checklist, not text-only slideshow
scenes.narration: Look at your last five dinners. How often would cooking two foods at once have saved an extra batch? That's your real test.

scenes.title: Verdict and direct guide
scenes.asset_requirement: Verified product comparison graphics, correct unchanged original logo, exact direct related buying-guide link in video description
scenes.narration: For simple cooking, start with the AF141. For regular mains and sides together, consider the AF400. For the full Australian comparison, use the buying guide linked first in this video's description.
